In a lunar calendar, the month approximates the cycle of the moon phase.
true_answer: Consecutive days may be grouped into other periods such as the week. Because the number of days in the tropical year is not a whole number, a solar calendar must have a diﬀerent number of days in diﬀerent years. is may be handled, for example, by adding an extra day in leap years. e same applies to months in a lunar calendar and also the number of months in a year in a lunisolar calendar. is is generally known as intercalation. Even if a calendar is solar, but not lunar, the year cannot be divided entirely into months that never vary in length.
